Summary.Name: CathEF-CLIP
Summary.Description: DeepCORO-CLIP based LVEF estimator from left coronary angiograms. Predicts continuous LVEF (%) and binary reduced-EF probability (<40%) from up to 4 videos per study.

Mechanism.Outcome: LVEF (%) regression and P(LVEF<40%) binary classification
Mechanism.Output: Value: LVEF in %; y_true_cat: probability that EF < 40% after sigmoid
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults undergoing coronary angiography at MHI

Model.Purpose: Estimate LVEF and reduced-EF probability from coronary angiograms

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Research preview for coronary angiogram-based LVEF estimation.
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: Adults with left coronary diagnostic angiograms; input is restricted to main_structure=Left Coronary and status=diagnostic.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Validated on MHI data only (AUC 0.911, MAE 5.98, Pearson r 0.685). Not validated for clinical use outside MHI.

Warnings_and_limitations.Number_of_videos: Uses up to 4 videos per study; extra videos are ignored.
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Reduced-EF threshold defaults to 0.5 on sigmoid probability and is tracked in class_mapping.json.
